messages:
Sofia (PM): Idea: create an 'express sandbox' flow for low-risk model onboards to shorten time-to-catalog while preserving safety. Key pieces: 48h smoke, 7d limited traffic, per-tenant pin opt-in, and a compact eval sweep. Agree?
Raj (Infra): Agree in principle. Must enforce hardware whitelist and autoscale floor. Also require a 'hold' flag so we can stop rollout instantly. Ops-bot can wire that in.
Ellen (ML): For quality gates suggest: p95 <= 140ms, micro-F1 >= 0.87 vs stable, and tokenization parity <= 2%. Add a small semantic spot-check of 12 samples. I'll run the sweep.
Omar (CS): Customers ask for clear pin expectations. Propose default TTL 45 days, auto-renew opt-out, and a one-click migration checklist in Console. We need a customer-facing FAQ too.
Ben (Sales): I'll prepare a one-line AE blurb: "Express sandbox: fast catalog entry + 45-day opt-in pin; longer pins via contract." Legal review will be required.
Ops-bot: Job created: job/express-sandbox-v1. Regions: us-west-2, eu-central-1. Alerts: latency_p95_exceed, error_rate_jump, infra_incident. Dashboard: /dash/express-sandbox.
Sofia (PM): Draft config (short):
```
flow: express_sandbox_v1
smoke_hours: 48
canary_days: 7
traffic_pct: 5
hardware_tags: [g5.xlarge]
bench_gates:
  latency_p95_ms: 140
  micro_f1_min: 0.87
  token_parity_pct: 2
pin_policy:
  tenant_opt_in: true
  default_ttl_days: 45
  auto_renew: false
  escape_hatch: runtime.hold=true
owners: [Sofia, Raj, Ellen, Omar]
```
Ellen (ML): Adding a drift monitor to the bench run. If embed drift > 3% or >2 human spot-check fails, flag fail.
Raj (Infra): I'll add the hold flag and autoscale floor, and enforce the hardware_tags. ETA: Friday.
Omar (CS): I'll draft the migration checklist and FAQ; include rollback expectations and recommended traffic ramp for unpinning. Draft by Monday.
Ben (Sales): Sending AE blurb to legal now, will post result in thread.
Sofia (PM): Decision owners = PM + Infra + ML + CS. Any veto pauses admission. Action items assigned. Scheduling a 20m sync next Tue to review bench + infra readiness.
